text: {"lessons":["Taking profits can feel rewarding, but I should avoid selling solely to lock in gains; consider each stock’s outlook and the portfolio’s risk and diversification.","Selling winners and holding losers can reflect loss aversion and the disposition effect. I should evaluate positions forward-looking, rather than letting gains or losses versus my average cost drive decisions.","A few months of returns and a rising account value do not prove a strategy works; keep decisions disciplined and consistent with my risk tolerance and long-term goals."]}
